keystones.name: Press the Attack
keystones.description: Hitting an enemy champion 3 consecutive times deals bonus damage and amplifies your damage until you leave combat with champions.

keystones.name: Lethal Tempo
keystones.description: Attacking an enemy champion grants you Attack Speed, up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, deal bonus adaptive damage On-Attack.

keystones.name: Fleet Footwork
keystones.description: Attacking and moving builds Energy stacks. At 100 stacks, your next attack heals you and grants increased MS.

keystones.name: Conqueror
keystones.description: Gain stacks of adaptive force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.

rows.name: Absorb Life
rows.description: Killing a target heals you.

rows.name: Triumph
rows.description: Takedowns restore 5% of your missing health and grant an additional 20 gold.

rows.name: Presence of Mind
rows.description: Restore a small amount of mana or energy when damaging an enemy champion. Takedowns restore mana or energy.

rows.name: Legend: Alacrity
rows.description: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Attack Speed.

rows.name: Legend: Haste
rows.description: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Basic Ability Haste.

rows.name: Legend: Bloodline
rows.description: Takedowns on enemies grant permanent Life Steal, up to a cap. Once the cap is reached, increase your max health. Weaker earlier but stronger later game than other Legend Runes.

rows.name: Coup de Grace
rows.description: Deal more damage to low health enemy champions.

rows.name: Cut Down
rows.description: Deal more damage to high health enemy champions.

rows.name: Last Stand
rows.description: Deal more damage to champions while you are low on health.

keystones.name: Electrocute
keystones.description: Hitting a champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities in 3s deals bonus adaptive damage.

keystones.name: Dark Harvest
keystones.description: Damaging a low health champion inflicts adaptive damage and harvests a soul from the victim.

keystones.name: Hail of Blades
keystones.description: Gain a large amount of Attack Speed and bonus true damage for the first 3 attacks made against enemy champions.

rows.name: Cheap Shot
rows.description: Deal bonus true damage to enemy champions with impaired movement or actions.

rows.name: Taste of Blood
rows.description: Heal when you damage an enemy champion.

rows.name: Sudden Impact
rows.description: Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal bonus true damage to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth.

rows.name: Sixth Sense
rows.description:
On a long Cooldown, automatically sense a nearby untracked and unseen ward, tracking it for the team.

Level 11: Also reveal the ward for 10s.

rows.name: Grisly Mementos
rows.description:
Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total.

Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected.

rows.name: Deep Ward
rows.description:
Your wards in the enemy jungle are Deep, gaining Health and Duration.

Level 9: Wards in the river are also Deep.

rows.name: Treasure Hunter
rows.description: Unique takedowns grant additional gold the first time they are collected.

rows.name: Relentless Hunter
rows.description: Unique takedowns grant permanent out of combat MS.

rows.name: Ultimate Hunter
rows.description: Unique takedowns grant permanent cooldown reduction on your Ultimate.

keystones.name: Summon Aery
keystones.description: Your attacks and abilities send Aery to a target, damaging enemies or shielding allies.

keystones.name: Arcane Comet
keystones.description: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a damaging comet at their location.

keystones.name: Stormraider's Surge
keystones.description: Dealing 25% of a champion's maximum health grants a burst of MS and Slow Resist.

keystones.name: Deathfire Touch
keystones.description: Damaging a champion with an ability burns them over time.

rows.name: Axiom Arcanist
rows.description: Your Ultimate has increased damage, healing, and shielding. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion reduces your Ultimate's current cooldown.

rows.name: Manaflow Band
rows.description:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 25, up to 250 mana.

After reaching 250 bonus mana, restore 1% of your missing mana every 5 seconds.

rows.name: Nimbus Cloak
rows.description: After casting a Summoner Spell, gain a short Move Speed increase that allows you to pass through units.

rows.name: Transcendence
rows.description:
Gain bonuses upon reaching the following levels:
Level 5: +5 Ability Haste
Level 8: +5 Ability Haste
Level 11: On Champion takedown, reduce the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20%.

rows.name: Celerity
rows.description: All Move Speed bonuses are 7% more effective on you and gain 1% Move Speed.

rows.name: Absolute Focus
rows.description: While above 70% health, gain extra adaptive damage.

rows.name: Scorch
rows.description: Your first damaging ability hit every 10s burns champions.

rows.name: Waterwalking
rows.description: Gain MS and AP or AD, adaptive in the river.

rows.name: Gathering Storm
rows.description: Gain increasing amounts of AD or AP, adaptive over the course of the game.

keystones.name: Grasp of the Undying
keystones.description: Every 4s your next attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage, heals you, and permanently increases your health.

keystones.name: Aftershock
keystones.description: After immobilizing an enemy champion gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you.

keystones.name: Guardian
keystones.description: Guard allies you cast spells on and those that are very nearby. If you or a guarded ally would take damage based on level, you're both granted a shield.

rows.name: Demolish
rows.description: Your third attack against turrets deals bonus damage.

rows.name: Font of Life
rows.description: Impairing the movement of an enemy champion heals nearby allied champions.

rows.name: Shield Bash
rows.description: Whenever you gain a shield, your next basic attack against a champion deals bonus adaptive damage.

rows.name: Conditioning
rows.description: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

rows.name: Second Wind
rows.description: After taking damage from an enemy champion heal back some missing health over time.

rows.name: Bone Plating
rows.description:
After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 spells or attacks you receive from them deal 30-60 (based on level) less damage.

Duration: 1.5s
Cooldown: 55s

rows.name: Overgrowth
rows.description: Gain permanent max health when minions or monsters die near you.

rows.name: Revitalize
rows.description:
Gain 5% Heal and Shield Power.

Heals and shields you cast or receive are 10% stronger on targets below 40% health.

rows.name: Unflinching
rows.description: Gain Armor and Magic Resist when receiving crowd control.

keystones.name: Glacial Augment
keystones.description: Immobilizing an enemy champion will cause 3 glacial rays that slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.

keystones.name: Unsealed Spellbook
keystones.description: Swap Summoner Spells while out of combat. Swapping to unique Summoner Spells will increase the rate at which you can make future swaps.

keystones.name: First Strike
keystones.description: When you initiate champion combat, deal 7% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain gold based on damage dealt.

rows.name: Hextech Flashtraption
rows.description:
While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash.

Hexflash: Channel, then blink to a new location.

rows.name: Magical Footwear
rows.description: You get free boots at 12 min but you cannot buy boots before then. Each takedown you get makes your boots come 45s sooner.

rows.name: Cash Back
rows.description: Get some gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.

rows.name: Triple Tonic
rows.description:
Upon reaching level 3, gain an Elixir of Avarice.
Upon reaching level 6, gain an Elixir of Force.
Upon reaching level 9, gain an Elixir of Skill.

rows.name: Time Warp Tonic
rows.description: Potions grant some restoration immediately.

rows.name: Biscuit Delivery
rows.description: Gain a free Biscuit every 2 min, until 6 min. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health and restores health.

rows.name: Cosmic Insight
rows.description:
+18 Summoner Spell Haste
+10 Item Haste

rows.name: Approach Velocity
rows.description: Bonus MS towards nearby enemy champions that are movement impaired, increased for enemy champions that you impair.

rows.name: Jack Of All Trades
rows.description:
For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste.

Gain bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks.
